text:
Carla M.: Quick sync — I'd like to run a short 'design swarm' to triage API surface + SDK ergonomics + Console UX for the new feature. Goal: surface blockers, agree on pre-read, and lock a canary plan.

Carla M.: Proposed format: 30–45m rapid feedback, demos from SDK + Console owners, focused list of 5 decision items. Not a deep design doc walkthrough — just outcomes.

Carla M.: Proposed slots (please react with ✅ or propose another):
• Wed 9:30–10:00 PT
• Wed 14:00–14:45 PT
• Thu 10:00–10:45 PT

Carla M.: Pre-read (please add any notes/comments in the doc before the session): https://drive.redwood.ai/s/feature-x-pre-read (one-pager + examples)
Console mockups: https://figma.com/file/abcdef/feature-x-console
SDK examples: https://drive.redwood.ai/s/sdk-snippets

Carla M.: Minimal pre-read checklist (copy into the doc if missing):
```
- One-paragraph problem statement + constraints
- 3 example API calls + expected responses
- SDK usage snippet for the main flow
- Console screenshots (happy / error states)
- List of open questions and expected decision level (design/PM/eng)
- Canary plan outline (who, where, rollback criteria)
```

Ben H.: ✅ Wed 14 works best for me. I can demo the SDK snippet (2–3 min).

Alisa T.: Morning only this week — Wed 9:30 if we can keep it to 30m. Can cover Console flows.

Devon R.: I can do Thu 10 if others prefer. I want a 5-min spot to show routing/fallback behavior.

Eva S.: Add an agenda item for model/versioning + rollout compatibility (we need to decide version pinning for SDKs).

Carla M.: Good call, @Eva S. I'll add "versioning & rollout constraints" as decision item #3.

Carla M.: If people can, paste any critical logs or failing examples under the pre-read doc. That'll make the session actionable.

Ben H.: Question: who should we invite beyond eng-platform? I'm thinking eng-runtime, eng-ml, and product.

Alisa T.: +1 to eng-runtime and product. eng-ml for model contract constraints.

Devon R.: Agree. Also ping infra for capacity/canary windows. @infra-bot can you suggest a safe canary window?

infra-bot: Suggested canary windows (based on current reserved capacity):
- Tue/Wed 02:00–06:00 UTC: low traffic
- Thu 22:00–02:00 UTC: maintenance window option

Carla M.: Thanks infra-bot — I'll propose Wed 14 PT for the sync and plan the canary for Tue 02:00 UTC (Dev + infra to confirm).

Alisa T.: Confirming — Wed 9:30 PT no longer works for me (calendar clash). If we're locked to Wed 14, fine.

Ben H.: Wed 14 ✅. Can keep it to 35m: 5m context, 10m SDK demo, 10m Console + routing notes, 10m decisions + next steps.

Eva S.: I'll prepare a short doc stub on versioning options (semantic pinning vs floating) and a recommended default.

Devon R.: I'll upload demo snippet and a short log of the fallback case to the SDK examples folder by EOD.

Carla M.: Action items before the session:
• All owners upload pre-read artifacts (one-pager, snippets, screenshots) — @Ben H., @Alisa T., @Devon R., @Eva S.
• Product: add acceptance criteria + success metrics in the pre-read doc
• Infra: confirm canary window and add contact on-call

Ben H.: I'll also paste a short migration notes block into the pre-read: code samples + recommended deprecation timeline.

Alisa T.: Noted. I'll add Console acceptance flows and two edge-case screenshots.

infra-bot: Canary window confirmed: Tue 02:00–05:00 UTC. On-call: @DevOps-oncall.

Carla M.: OK locking Wed 14:00–14:35 PT. I created a calendar invite and added the pre-read links. Please RSVP and add comments inline. Invite includes eng-platform, eng-runtime, eng-ml, product, infra.

Ben H.: RSVP'd 👍

Devon R.: RSVP'd. Will upload demo by 18:00 PT.

Eva S.: RSVP'd. Doc stub added.

Alisa T.: RSVP'd. Will keep slides to 3.

Carla M.: Thanks everyone — see you Wed 14. If anything urgent pops up, ping me or update the doc. :thumbsup:

Ben H.: quick follow-up — should we record? Helpful for PMs who can't join.

Carla M.: Yes, please record. I'll note the recording + notes will live in the pre-read folder.
